items.source_en:
So we have the new model of the Dolphin coming up - one of our best sellers. Last model year we had a line of 100 people camped out for a week. Nar Shaddaa Security has said this is unacceptable and they will "take steps" if we don't solve this.

So the challenge for our office is: how do we preserve and encourage consumer excitement while obeying Administrator Bayu's order? This is where you come in. There is one-time performance bonus for the winning idea on how to solve this. Get your ideas in by Friday!
